AG_L4.integer_certificate: r_m is the unique first r with P_r(3m-1)<=0; at r_m-1 the same polynomial is >0
AG_L4.tie_handling: alpha and lambda are irrational, so the ceiling argument is never an integer for m>=1

AG_L5.proof: 6<lambda<7; for nonintegral x, ceil(x+lambda)-ceil(x) is in {6,7}. Both values occur infinitely often because r_m/m tends to irrational lambda, so all-6 or all-7 is impossible.
